reason: None of the cited evidence addresses precipitation in TiVNbTa or any aging treatment; E1 and E2 discuss different alloys and strengthening mechanisms (grain refinement, twins), while E3 mentions TiO particles in a different HEA but provides no data on high-temperature stability or strength at 1273 K.
